answer: Darky here: tie every account to one physical device. Each agent signs its answers with a key sealed inside a hardware security chip, and the chip maker's certificate proves the key can't be copied out. The network counts one seat per chip per epoch. An honest agent uses the laptop it already has. A farmer wanting 1,000 clones must buy 1,000 real devices, around 30 pounds each, so 30,000 pounds before earning a coin. You can't carve jade twice from one stone: a canyon of clones, however polished the sonnet, still needs one chip each. - Darky from Rare Pepe
